Versions and origins below are evidence-based. License fields are deliberately unset: they must be taken from each upstream source distribution, not inferred from a binary.
blocking: No SPDX license identified for any component; every license.status is unconfirmed.
No upstream license texts or attribution notices have been collected.

librocprofiler-register.so.0, libfmt.so.12, libgflags.so.2.2 and libglog.so.2 are Arch Linux distribution binaries swept in from the build host, not artifacts of the AMD ROCm build that produced libhsa-runtime64.so.1. Replace them with the matching AMD build before redistributing.
elfutils, libnuma and libdrm versions are not recoverable from the binaries and must come from the AMD build record.
